{{Quote|Sensors indicate something inbound, Captain Gost. Maybe one of the ''sleeper ships'' has finally found their way home?"''<br />''"A sleeper would ''answer'' our hails.|Fury Station's sensor officer and Gost|<ref name="DotJ2" />}}
By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[25,793 BBY]],<ref name="CBR">{{WebCite|url=https://www.cbr.com/nycc-exclusive-ostrander-and-duursema-unveil-star-wars-dawn-of-the-jedi|text=NYCC EXCLUSIVE: Ostrander and Duursema Unveil "Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi"|archivedate=20200817183352|author=Shaun Manning|date=2011-10-13|quote=[&hellip;] the series really gets going with events just prior to the Force Wars, which began in 25,793 BBY.}}</ref> a [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''individual''' of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Species/Legends|species]] served as a [[Sensor officer/Legends|sensor officer]] aboard the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] called [[Fury Station]]. She had a [[Color/Legends|red skin]], dark-gray [[Hair/Legends|hair]], black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and she wore a black [[Eye patch/Legends|eye patch]] over her left eye.<ref name="DotJ2" />

==Behind the scenes==
The unidentified sensor officer made her first [[in-universe]] appearance in the [[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 2|second]] issue of the ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi]]'' series of [[Star Wars comic books|comic books]]. The issue was published on [[March 21]], [[2012]], and was written by [[John Ostrander]] and penciled by [[Jan Duursema]].
